structural_change: KV-FIX3 es2: ONE clock entry ck (was 4 CTS roots ck_station/ck_static/ck_boot/ck_boot_test, all tapped from the same die net clk_core_<stack>); es1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD FF -110 ps = cross-root internal hops paying the 100 ps die-skew hold reserve (boot->static ctrl_er->u_static.er -131.9, static->core -119, core->static -96, static->boot -95, test->boot -53; 5,695 endpoints; pc1 needed ~15k hold buffers). 6,999 sinks on one root (<15k). 0 cycles, bit-identical. | new kit route: same RTL as qkd_hslice es1, dn pin plan | KV-TILES-C es2 (10-17): recipe 2 -> 4 with hold_budget die (FLOW-HOLD): the RTL is flop-first at every pin (PINCAP + ESPIN), so the inhold / outhold HB2 pin pads (pc1: ctrl_es[1] launch 411.7 ps through the outhold pad) are dropped and boundary hold is the die's; io_flop_at_pins keeps each pin flop at its face.

reroute_reason.fix: es1 (qkd_hslice-es1-b9d1bfc48 / qkd_hslice_dn-es1-b9d1bfc48) EARLY_FAIL_HOLD FF -110 ps: 4 CTS roots of one die clock net charged 100 ps cross-root hold reserve on internal hops; RTL es2 = single clock port ck (one root); keeps es1 ESPIN/PINCAP pin stages (native launch fix of pc1 241.7 ps) ; recipe 4 hold_budget die (flop-first pins, no inhold/outhold pads)
